findings.title: Round-trip test does not fully verify success criterion 5
findings.description: Task 1.4 only reloads the YAML and asserts that the policy matches. Slice success criterion 5 additionally requires `config_to_yaml` to emit the policy as a plain string and reloading the emitted YAML to produce an **equal `ServerConfig`**. Extend the test to inspect the serialized YAML value and assert equality between the original and reloaded configurations, rather than checking only `world_bounds.policy`.

findings.title: Integration-test setup does not guarantee the prescribed boundary crossings
findings.description: The shared setup specifies positions, outward velocities, and `forces=[]`, but not `dt`, profile `max_speed`, or concrete velocity magnitudes. Engine integration still advances positions by `velocity * dt` and clamps speed even with no forces. Consequently, the agent at `(99, 50)` with velocity `(10, 0)` may remain inside the world after one step—for example, with `dt=0.05`—so `vx < 0` would not hold. Specify deterministic fixture values, including `dt` and `max_speed`, that guarantee the one-step crossing and guarantee at least one `OPEN` agent exits during the 50-step run.

findings.title: Commit markers incorrectly use checkbox syntax
findings.description: All five commit markers are checklist items, for example `- [ ] **Commit:** ...`, rather than plain `**Commit**:` lines. The same defect appears at lines 179, 249, 286, and 325. Convert them to plain, non-checkbox markers. Their placement after tested section-level work is otherwise appropriate.

findings.title: Manual verification can leave the required shipped configuration changed
findings.description: Task 5.1 runs the final suite before Task 5.2 edits `config/test.yaml` to `reflect` and then `open`. Step 8 permits restoring “whichever policy you want,” although success criterion 12 requires the shipped file to retain `policy: wrap`. Require restoration of the committed `wrap` version and perform the final verification after that restoration, so temporary manual-testing edits cannot become the final state.

findings.title: Breakdown is over-decomposed for a 2/5-effort slice
findings.description: The 325-line breakdown uses 23 task headings and extensive implementation/test prescriptions for a small enum, helper module, call site, and two YAML edits. Merge Tasks 1.1–1.3 into one config implementation task, Tasks 2.1–2.2 into one module task, and Tasks 4.1–4.2 into one shipped-config task. Fold the documentation closeout tasks together, remove the redundant parametrized dispatch test—the policy-specific public-function tests already exercise dispatch—and avoid repeating the full-suite run unless it is retained as the post-restoration final check. Keep the policy edge-case tests because those directly support the success criteria.
